actives.name: Triple Slash
actives.desc:
A constant pattern of 3 distinct strikes, each dealing Physical Damage and inflicting different effects.
Attack 1: Shakes enemy for .
Attack 2: Deals additional damage to Tripped enemies.
Attack 3: Increases Melee damage +30% and hits multiple enemies in front of you.
Does not trigger a global cooldown. Hold down for continuous use.

ancestrals.desc: Fast single-target 3-hit Lightning combo (140% + 140% + 190% Melee Attack).
Heavy AoE 3-hit Quake slashes (180% + 180% + 260% Melee Attack).

actives.name: Charge
actives.desc:
Launches a rush toward an enemy that deals Physical Damage and inflicts Snare for .
Snare duration reduced -50% in PvP.
Can't be used while Snared.

actives.name: Whirlwind Slash
actives.desc:
A spinning attack with up to 3 distinct strikes, each dealing Physical Damage to many nearby enemies.
Attack 1: Deals additional damage to Shaken targets, and Trips Slowed targets
Attack 2: Deals additional damage to Tripped targets.
Attack 3: Shoves nearby targets away from you.
No cooldown between strikes. Hold down for continuous use.

actives.name: Sunder Earth
actives.desc:
Smashes open a fault line in front of you, dealing Physical damage to all enemies in its path and decreasing their Move Speed -60% for .
All allies in the area of effect gain Earth Energy, decreasing received damage -30% for up to 7 seconds.

actives.name: Lasso
actives.desc: Pulls a distant enemy to your position. This ability also Taunts the target, forcing affected monsters to attack you for 4 seconds.

actives.name: Terrifying Roar
actives.desc:
Weakens all enemies within m for . 
Also Toughens the caster for the same amount of time, reducing the duration of those debuffs.

actives.name: Bondbreaker
actives.desc:
Removes all Snared, Slowed, and Lassitude effects from the caster, and grants immunity to these effects for . Can only be used while under one of these effects.
Can be used during global cooldown, and does not trigger a global cooldown.

actives.name: Precision Strike
actives.desc: Delivers a powerful attack that deals Physical Damage.

ancestrals.desc:
Inflicts 613 (576 + 360% Melee Attack) Physical damage to a single target.
Increases Critical Damage +60%. 
Increases Melee Critical Hit Rate +34% when attacking targets with less than 30% max Health.

Deals 613 (576 + 360% Melee Attack) Physical Damage to a single target.
Increases Critical Damage 60%. Backstabbing increases Melee Critical Rate +34%.
This skill's Cooldown resets if it kills the target.

actives.name: Frenzy
actives.desc:
Increases Melee Attack and Magic Attack +30 whenever damage is received, and absorbs 21% of received Magic Damage.
Increases Move Speed +5% and reduces Physical Defense -10% each time you damage an enemy.
Decreases Battlerage Mana Cost -50%.
Effect lasts for , but increases by + per kill. Stuns you for 4 seconds when Frenzy ends.

actives.name: Battle Focus
actives.desc: Doesn't trigger a global cooldown.

actives.name: Tiger Strike
actives.desc:
Launches a rush past an enemy dealing Physical Damage.
Repeats up to 5 times if other enemies are nearby.
Can't be countered with Evasion, Block, or Parry.
Can't be used while Snared.

ancestrals.desc:
Rushes past the same enemy 3 times, inflicting 441 (422 + 180% Melee Attack) Physical Damage each time.
This skill cannot be evaded, blocked, or parried. 
Can't be used while Snared.

Rushes past an enemy, dealing 688 (660 + 280% Melee Attack) Physical Damage.
Repeats up to 5 times if other enemies are nearby, and grants immunity to all harmful effects for the duration.
This skill cannot be evaded, blocked, or parried. 
Can't be used while Snared.

actives.name: Behind Enemy Lines
actives.desc:
Triggers a high leap that lands at a designated site, dealing Physical Damage and Snaring nearby enemies for .
Cancels Bubble Trap, Petrify, and Telekinesis effects.
Can't be used while Snared.
Snare duration reduced -50% in PvP.

passives.name: Weapon Maneuvers
passives.desc: Increases Melee Attack +5%.

passives.name: Dual-Wield Proficiency
passives.desc:
When dual-wielding, Parry deflects Ranged Attacks as well.
Increases Melee Crit Rate +8%.

passives.name: Attack Speed Training
passives.desc:
Decreases the cooldown of Battlerage skills-10%. Grants one stack of Delirium for every Battlerage Critical Hit, and for every enemy hit by the 3rd attack of Whirlwind Slash.

Delirium:
- Melee Skill Damage +2%. 
- Melee Critical Damage +5% .
- Stacks up to 5 times. 
- Grants a 5% chance of inflicting Bleed on targets.

passives.name: Deflect and Retaliate
passives.desc:
Permanently increases Parry rate +2% each successful parry resets the cooldown on all Battlerage attack skills.
This ability has a 12sec cooldown once triggered.

passives.name: Reckless Charge
passives.desc: Using Charge, Tiger Strike, or Behind Enemy Lines decreases received Physical Damage -15%, and decreases the duration of Shackle, Slow, Snare, and Impale -35% for 4 seconds.

passives.name: Puncture
passives.desc: Melee Critical attacks decrease the target's Physical Defense -2000 for 5 seconds.

passives.name: Weapon Mastery
passives.desc: Increases Battlerage skill damage +15%.

hatredActives.name: Soulbound Blades
hatredActives.desc: Throws otherworldly blades that surround the target, dealing damage to the target (if cast on an enemy) and all nearby enemies.

hatredActives.name: Rising Hatred
hatredActives.desc:
Increases maximum Abyssal Charges +2 for 12 seconds. Prevents charges from naturally depleting for the duration, and doubles charges gained through using skills.
Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the duration.

hatredActives.name: Swordfall
hatredActives.desc:
Call down swords from the sky to Impale enemies in front of you, dealing up to Physical Damage. Use this skill again to stop channeling early. The longer you channel, the more damage will be dealt. 
If cast while at 6 Abyssal Charges, additional swords are summoned, inflicting more damage the closer an enemy is to the center of the effect.

hatredPassives.name: Raging Berserker
hatredPassives.desc: Charge, Precision Strike, Tiger Strike, Behind Enemy Lines, and the third hit of Whirlwind Slash each grant 1 Abyssal Charge whenever they're used.

actives.name: Earthen Grip
actives.desc:
Calls forth a hand from the ground to hold an enemy, inflicting Snare for .
Deals Magic Damage on expiration.
Being damaged by a direct attack will free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect.
Snare duration reduced -50% in PvP.

ancestrals.desc:
Calls forth hands from the ground that grab all enemies within 8m, inflicting Snare for 12s.
Deals 177 (86 + 220% Magic Attack) Magic Damage upon expiration.
Being damaged by a direct attack will free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect. 
Snare duration reduced -50% in PvP.

Calls forth a hand from the ground to hold an enemy, inflicting Snare for 12s.
Deals 177 (86 + 220% Magic Attack) Magic Damage upon expiration.
Being damaged by a direct attack will free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect. 
Snare duration reduced -50% in PvP.
This skill has a reduced Cast Time compared to regular Earthen Grip, but also has a shorter range.

actives.name: Enervate
actives.desc: Deals Magic Damage and burns mana over . Decreases healing effectiveness -60% and increases duration of Stun and Trip +30%.

actives.name: Bubble Trap
actives.desc:
Traps an enemy inside a bubble for and slowly lifts it into the air. 
Enemies in bubbles can't attack, but take -50% less Magic Damage.
Being damaged by a direct attack will free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect.
Bubble duration reduced -50% in PvP.

ancestrals.desc:
Traps an enemy inside a bubble for 10.8s and slowly lifts it into the air. Enemies in bubbles can't attack, but take -50% less Magic Damage.
Being damaged by a direct attack will free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect. 
Bubble duration reduced -50% in PvP.
This skill has a reduced Cooldown compared to regular Bubble Trap, but also has a shorter range.

Summons a mist at the target location that lasts for 15 seconds, affecting all enemies within a 4m radius.
Each time an enemy enters the mist it becomes trapped in a bubble, rising into the air for 5.4s.
Enemies in bubbles can't attack, but take -50% less Magic Damage.
Being damaged by a direct attack will free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect. 
Bubble duration reduced -50% in PvP.

actives.name: Insidious Whisper
actives.desc:
Inflicts Fear on an enemy and causes it to flee from the caster for .
Being damaged by a direct attack has a chance to free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect.

actives.name: Purge
actives.desc:
Allies: Removes 1 negative effect. 
Enemies: Removes 1 buff.

actives.name: Play Dead
actives.desc: Allows caster to play dead to escape danger. Caster can revive at any time. Restores 1% of the caster's health and mana every second if they are below 30%. Effect ends with movement.

actives.name: Courageous Action
actives.desc: Awakens caster or an ally and grants immunity to Sleep for .

actives.name: Lassitude
actives.desc: Magically fatigues the target, causing them to fall asleep for after a delay. Enemies will wake upon taking damage. Sleep duration reduced -50% in PvP.

actives.name: Banshee Wail
actives.desc:
Causes Fear in all nearby enemies for , forcing them to flee and Stunning them for 2 seconds.
Being damaged by a direct attack has a chance to free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect.

ancestrals.desc:
Causes Fear in all nearby enemies for 2.8s, forcing them to flee. 
This skill reduces affected enemies' Move Speed -40% for the duration, but does not stun them afterwards like regular Banshee Wail.
Being damaged by a direct attack has a chance to free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect.

Summons a Phantasm at the target location for 6 seconds, which inflicts Fear on all enemies within a 5m radius every second. Feared enemies flee for up to 2.8s, then are Stunned for 2 seconds afterward.
Being damaged by a direct attack has a chance to free the target early, but debuffs that deal damage over time will not end this effect. 
The duration of this skill's Fear effect is not affected by the caster's Passive skills.
Cannot be used in conjunction with Mist Summon Wraith (Occultism).

actives.name: Focal Concussion
actives.desc:
Deals Magic Damage and Stuns an enemy for .
If the target has any positive buffs, Focal Concussion removes one buff and deals additional damage when the Stun ends.

actives.name: Dahuta's Breath
actives.desc: Sends forth a wave that deals Magic Damage and pushes enemies back.

actives.name: Fiend's Knell
actives.desc:
Summons a fiend for up to 30 seconds that relentlessly attacks enemies with special skills.
Summons only one demon, which can't be healed.

passives.name: Folding Time
passives.desc: Decreases Cast Time for all skills -4%.

passives.name: Illusion's Favor
passives.desc:
Increases Health Regen +7 every 1 second.
Decreases Cast Time for Earthen Grip and Insidious Whisper -0.5 seconds.

passives.name: Magic Detection
passives.desc: Increases Magic Defense +500.

passives.name: Mitigation
passives.desc:
Decreases received Melee damage -30% for 3 seconds after receiving a Melee Critical Hit.
This ability has a 20sec cooldown once triggered.

passives.name: Baleful Recharge
passives.desc:
Your successful attacks have a 2% chance to trigger the Baleful Recharge buff, restoring a percentage of your maximum mana with every attack for the following 5 seconds. This ability has a 12sec cooldown once triggered. In addition, each enemy you Fear using Banshee's Wail or Insidious Whisper grants a stack of Exploitation.

Exploitation:
- Decreases the Cooldown of Focal Concussion and Enervate -10% per stack.
- Stacks up to 5 times.
- Casting either spell consumes one stack.
- While under the effects of Exploitation, both spells will deal 90% of their damage as mana burn instead of normal damage, restoring an equal amount of mana to you.

passives.name: Augment Witchcraft
passives.desc:
Increases the duration of Earthen Grip, Bubble Trap, Insidious Whisper, Lassitude, and Banshee Wail +20%.
Fiend's Knell now summons a more powerful fiend that last for 5 minutes, tripping enemies where it is summoned. Increases the cooldown on Fiend's Knell to 2m 30sec.

passives.name: Enshroud
passives.desc: Decreases Witchcraft skill cooldown -20%.

hatredActives.name: Devour Hope
hatredActives.desc:
Inflicts a crippling despair on your chosen victim for .

Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the range of the skill.

hatredPassives.name: Spiteful Curses
hatredPassives.desc: Earthen Grip, Bubble Trap, Insidious Whisper, Lassitude, and Focal Concussion each grant 1 Abyssal Charges whenever they're used.

actives.name: Shield Slam
actives.desc: Swings your shield at an enemy, dealing Physical Damage and Stunning them for .

ancestrals.desc:
Strike an enemy with your shield, dealing 50 (46 + 50% Melee Attack) Physical Damage. Interrupts the target, canceling all Cast Time, Channeled, and Ongoing skills.
This skill has a dramatically shorter Cooldown than regular Shield Slam, but deals less damage and does not Stun.
Swing your shield in an arc, dealing 70 (57 + 130% Melee Attack) Physical Damage to multiple enemies in front of you and Stunning them for 1.5s.

Only works on caster.

This ability also Provokes the target, forcing affected players to target you and affected monsters to attack you.

actives.name: Toughen

Lasts .

Restores + Health plus an amount equal to 50% of your stacked Mettle.
Consumes all stacked Mettle and cures one debuff.

Raises a shield around the caster for .

Builds additional Aggro equal to 100% of your stacked Mettle, consuming all stacks of Mettle when cast.

actives.name: Imprison
actives.desc: Imprisons all enemies within a boundary for 12 seconds. Enemies can break out if they use enough force.

hatredActives.name: Abyssal Echoes
hatredActives.desc:
Ends all currently active Perform skills, but creates diminished echoes of those abilities for up to 10 seconds. These echoes only affect the caster, and are not interrupted by casting non-perform skills. Using additional Perform skills during this time will end the echoes early.
As this skill levels up, the effects of the echoes improve.

hatredActives.name: Rising Hatred
hatredActives.desc:
Increases maximum Abyssal Charges +2 for 12 seconds. Prevents charges from naturally depleting for the duration, and doubles charges gained through using skills.
Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the duration.

hatredActives.name: Polymorphic Resonance
hatredActives.desc:
For up to 25 seconds, grants temporary immortality to allies within a 15m radius. When subjected to fatal damage, affected allies instead transform into animals and recover a small amount of Health, becoming temporarily immune to all debuffs.
This spell has an initial duration of 3 seconds, and consumes any additional Abyssal Charges over time to extend the duration 3 seconds per charge. If cast while at 6 Abyssal Charges, it has an initial duration of 5 seconds and each extra charge extends the duration 5 seconds instead.
Effect ends when no charges remain or another ability is used.

hatredPassives.name: Seething Songs
hatredPassives.desc: Startling Strain, Dissonance, Healing Hymn, Rhythmic Renewal, and Alarm Call each gant 1 Abyssal Charge whenever they're used.

actives.name: Holy Bolt
actives.desc: Fires a bolt of holy light that deals Magic Damage.

actives.name: Mirror Light
actives.desc:
Caster/allies: Cures one debuff and increases received healing +15% for .
Enemies: Inflicts Snare for . Increases received damage +12% and decreases healing effectiveness -30% for . Snare duration reduced -50% in PvP.

actives.name: Antithesis
actives.desc:
Allies/caster: Instantly restores + Health.
Enemies: Deals Magic Damage.
Hold ALT to use on yourself.

ancestrals.desc:
Instantly restores 908 (461 + 440% Healing Power) Health for you or an ally.
This skill has a longer range than regular Antithesis, but cannot be used to damage enemies. 
Hold ALT to use the skill on yourself.

Instantly restores 613 (288 + 320% Healing Power) Health to all allies within a 6m radius of the target, and deals 1026 (864 + 160% Healing Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the same area.
Can be used on both allies or enemies.
Hold ALT to use the skill on yourself.
Deals +35% extra damage to monsters.

actives.name: Resurgence
actives.desc:
Regenerates Health over for you or an ally.
Hold ALT to use the skill on yourself.

actives.name: Revive
actives.desc:
Revives an ally and restores the XP lost at death in the same amount as Nui's resurrection.
Revived target: 
Can't be used during combat.

actives.name: Skewer
actives.desc: Summons four skewers within a 20m circle at the target area, dealing Magic Damage and Impaling enemies for , preventing all actions. Skewers deal more damage where they overlap. When this skill levels up, it increases in both damage and cast time.

ancestrals.desc: Summons four skewers within a 20m circle at the target location, Impaling enemies for 2.6s and restoring 938 Health to allies. Skewers heal twice as much where they overlap.

Summons Skewers in a 5m radius at the target location.Can be used up to 3 times in a row without casting delay, but the damage is reduced on consecutive casts.
Skewers deal 1958 (1677 + 276% Healing Power) Magic Damage and Impale their targets for 2.6s, preventing all actions.
Deals +35% extra damage to monsters.

actives.name: Mend
actives.desc:
Restores + health to up to 10 allies within a 20m radius.

Affected allies are protected for a short period of time (does not stack with Insulating Lens).

Grants immunity to Fear, but does not remove existing Fear effects.

actives.name: Aranzeb's Boon
actives.desc: Applies to caster and nearby raid members for 30 minutes.

actives.name: Renewal
actives.desc:
Calls forth energy from the land to bless the caster or an ally for 30sec. 
Hold ALT to use on yourself.

actives.name: Fervent Healing
actives.desc:
Instantly restores Health for you or an ally. When used repeatedly, this skill heals 25% more Health, but at the cost of more Mana and a longer cooldown.
Can be used up to 5 times in a row.
Hold ALT to use the skill on yourself.

ancestrals.desc:
Instantly restores 312 (170 + 140% Healing Power) Health for you or an ally. This skill has no Cooldown, but the Mana cost increases by 50% of the base Mana cost per cast.
Mana cost resets 10 seconds after the most recent cast.

Restores 351 (311 + 40% Healing Power) Health every second for up to 25 seconds for you or an ally.
Use this skill again while channeling to cast the spell early. The longer you channel, the more powerful the healing effect will be. 
Hold ALT to use the skill on yourself.

actives.name: Infuse
actives.desc: Consumes caster's mana to immediately restore the mana of up to 10 allies within 20m. Restores 8-11% of each target's max mana.

actives.name: Whirlwind's Blessing
actives.desc: Increases Attack Speed +250 and Move Speed +20% for allies within 30m, and decreases Attack Speed -175 and Move Speed -15% for enemies for 30 seconds.

passives.name: Painful Recharge
passives.desc: Converts 3% of received damage to mana.

passives.name: Quick Recovery
passives.desc: Resets cooldowns on all Vitalism healing skills after receiving critical damage or critical healing. If Quick Recovery is triggered too often, it will be disabled for 12 seconds.
passives.shortEffect: Reset Vitalism CD on Crit Taken

passives.name: Spirit Growth
passives.desc: Increases Spirit +9%.

passives.name: Alms
passives.desc: Decreases Cast Time for all skills -6%.

passives.name: Invigorated Healing
passives.desc: Increases Critical Heal Bonus +25%.

passives.name: Defiance
passives.desc:
Increases Magic Defense +500 for all allies within a 15m radius.
Grants the Prayer effect every time Antithesis, Mend, or Fervent Healing is cast.

Prayer:
- Decreases Cast Time -2% per stack.
- Triggers Sacrifice at 5 stacks.

Sacrifice:
- Consumes 12-16% of current health when triggered.
- Decreases Cast Time -10%.
- Adds powerful bonus effects to Mend and Infuse.
- Lasts 15sec.
- Prevents gaining stacks of Prayer for duration.

passives.name: Joyous Spirit
passives.desc:
Decreases Vitalism skill cooldown -20%. 
Increases Post-Cast Mana Regen based on Spirit whenever damage is received while below 40% mana.

hatredActives.name: Abyssal Petrification
hatredActives.desc:
Removes all debuffs and aggro from a selected target and protects them against all damage for , but prevents them from moving or taking actions for the duration. 
Using this skill on a petrified target reverses the effects.

hatredActives.name: Rising Hatred
hatredActives.desc:
Increases maximum Abyssal Charges +2 for 12 seconds. Prevents charges from naturally depleting for the duration, and doubles charges gained through using skills.
Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the duration.

hatredActives.name: Defy Death
hatredActives.desc:
Revives up to 6 allies within 6m of the caster. All targets beyond the first must be in the same party or raid as the caster to be revived. Any additional charges are consumed on casting, increasing the health and mana of revived targets. 
Consuming 6 Abyssal Charges increases the affected range to 20m. 
Can be used in combat.

hatredPassives.name: Profane Prayers
hatredPassives.desc: Antithesis, Mirror Light, Mend, Fervent Healing, and Infuse each grant 1 Abyssal Charge whenever they're used on the caster or their allies.
